- Fretboard — wenge
  - Tone/feel: wenge is a dense, bright-sounding hardwood with a firm attack and tight low-end response; the surface feels slightly coarse compared with ebony or rosewood.
  - Practical: listed as an included option for EMBLA. Stable and hard-wearing; no special mounting constraints.

- Pickups — Delano SBC HE/S-4 (Delano SBC)
  - Role: full-sized SBC-format humbuckers providing strong output, clear low-mid definition and good string-to-string separation—well-suited for pop and session tones.
  - Constraint: Delano SBC HE/S-4 is listed as "included" for EMBLA but the catalog requests confirmation of mounting and route depth (SBC5 housing: 100 × 36 × 18.5 mm). RavenForge will confirm cavity dimensions, screw positions and wiring during the build.

- Onboard EQ — Zuta Bass Core
  - Role: active electronics package included on EMBLA for shaping tone (clean boost / active shaping useful for sessions and varied patches).
  - Constraint: Zuta Bass Core is the standard packaged electronics; if you later want a different preamp (John East, Underhill, etc.) those are selectable and may carry extra cost or require different cavity/component fit.

- Other related items affecting tone/playability
  - nut_material = brass zero-fret string guide: the zero fret defines the open-string contact point, giving more consistent open-string feel/timbre versus a traditional nut.
  - coil_switch = 1 × parallel-series: this switch operates both pickups together (parallel vs series) to broaden tonal options but does not give individual pickup coil-splitting per pickup.
